description: Search remote, hybrid and non-bedside nurse jobs on Off the Floor (https://offthefloornurse.com). Filter by role family, US state, fully remote and license. Returns counts for every match (total_matching, free_preview_matching, locked_matching) and the free preview listings that match, in full: title, employer, posted pay, work mode, location, states and a link to the listing page. Listings outside the free preview are counted only; a plan on the site shows their employer, pay and apply link. Data is re-read from employers' own career sites (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby) when the board is rebuilt; each result gives data_updated_at.

license.description: License the listing accepts: RN, LPN (LPN/LVN) or NP.

limit.description: How many free preview listings to return, 1 to 20. Default 10. Counts always cover every match.

remote_only.description: Only fully remote listings (work mode remote). Default false.

role.description: Role family. One of: utilization-review (Utilization review), case-management (Case management), telehealth (Telehealth), triage (Phone triage), documentation (Documentation and coding), quality (Quality), informatics (Informatics), education (Education), other (Other off-the-floor).

state.description: A US state as a 2-letter code ("TX") or full name ("Texas"), any case. Matches listings that name the state, plus remote listings open across the US.

name: search_jobs
title: Search nurse jobs
